releases.notes:
## PV-SVC Bridge 1.0.1

Forge and NeoForge builds are now available alongside Fabric. This update fixes audio device selection, microphone testing, and connection retries.

### Changes

- Added Forge and NeoForge support, Minecraft 1.16.5 builds, and selected Minecraft 26.x builds.
- Fixed microphone and speaker names and device switching in Plasmo Voice settings.
- Fixed the unavailable microphone test button and switching devices while listening to your own voice.
- Fixed resuming voice transmission after microphone testing on Forge.
- Added connection retries when the server does not respond to the first request.
- Added SVC protocol negotiation for protocols 17, 18, and 20.

### Downloads

51 individual JARs are attached: 25 for Fabric, 14 for Forge, and 12 for NeoForge. Choose the file matching both your Minecraft version and loader.

| Loader | Minecraft versions |
| --- | --- |
| Fabric | 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.3, 1.20.4, 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3 |
| Forge | 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.4, 1.21, 1.21.1 |
| NeoForge | 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3 |

- `pv-svc-bridge-1.0.1-all-jars.zip` contains all 51 builds, grouped by loader. Extract only the JAR you need into `mods`.
- Separate Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge ZIP archives are also attached.
- `pv-svc-bridge-1.0.1-source.zip` contains the complete source and Gradle wrappers. GitHub's Source code ZIP and TAR.GZ downloads point to the same release commit.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for all attached JARs and ZIP archives.

### Requirements

Install Plasmo Voice 2.1.16 or newer for your Minecraft version and loader. Fabric also requires Fabric API. Place the bridge JAR alongside Plasmo Voice in `mods`.

The Simple Voice Chat client mod is not required. This is a client addon; no bridge addon is needed on the server. Plasmo Voice remains the preferred backend when available.

### Compatibility and testing

All 51 profiles passed local build, test, and artifact checks. Forge 1.21.1 was checked with Plasmo Voice 2.1.16 and 2.1.17 against a local Simple Voice Chat server, including connection retries, voice packet transmission, microphone monitoring, device switching, and disconnect cleanup. Earlier in-game audio testing covered Fabric 1.21.11. Other profiles still need in-game testing; a conversation with another player on a public server has not been retested.

Only versions listed in the table have a 1.0.1 build. See [release targets](https://github.com/Hacer599/PlasmoVoice-Simple-Voice-Chat-Integration/blob/v1.0.1/release/targets.json) for the matching voice mod versions.

### По-русски

Добавлены сборки для Forge и NeoForge, поддержка Minecraft 1.16.5 и выбранных версий 26.x. Исправлены выбор микрофона и динамика, проверка микрофона и переключение устройств во время прослушивания. На Forge передача голоса возобновляется после завершения проверки микрофона. Если сервер не ответил на запрос подключения, мост отправляет его повторно. Поддерживаются протоколы SVC 17, 18 и 20.

В релизе 51 JAR. Выбери файл под свою версию Minecraft и загрузчик из таблицы выше. Есть общий ZIP, отдельные архивы по загрузчикам и ZIP с исходниками. Из архива со сборками нужен только один подходящий JAR.

Нужен Plasmo Voice 2.1.16 или новее, для Fabric также нужен Fabric API. Клиентский мод Simple Voice Chat устанавливать не требуется.

Все сборки прошли локальные автоматические проверки. Проверка клиента Forge проводилась на 1.21.1 с локальным SVC-сервером; ранее звук проверялся на Fabric 1.21.11. Остальные версии требуют проверки в игре. Разговор с другим игроком на публичном сервере повторно не проверялся.

releases.notes:
## PV-SVC Bridge 1.0.0 - First release

A Fabric client addon for Plasmo Voice that implements the Simple Voice Chat client protocol. Use Plasmo Voice on compatible Simple Voice Chat servers without installing the Simple Voice Chat client mod.

### Downloads
- 26 individual Fabric JARs are attached, one for each supported Minecraft version from 1.17.1 through 1.21.11. Download the JAR matching your Minecraft version.
- `pv-svc-bridge-1.0.0-source.zip` contains the project source and Gradle wrapper for building locally.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader and Fabric API
- Plasmo Voice 2.1.16 or newer
- Install the addon JAR alongside Plasmo Voice in the Minecraft `mods` folder.

### Compatibility and testing
All listed version profiles have been build-checked. Runtime audio has been tested on Minecraft 1.21.11; older Minecraft versions still need in-game testing with matching Simple Voice Chat server releases. SVC protocol compatibility depends on the server protocol version.

This is a client-side addon. No Simple Voice Chat client mod or server-side addon is required. Plasmo Voice remains the preferred backend when available.
